title: Briefing for 2026-10-22
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-10-22: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.
us: UK inflation jumps to 3.5% — cementing rate hike expectations. Housing is flashing warning signs just as the Fed weighs more interest rate hikes. India’s finance minister says market liquidity makes it easier for investors to exit. U.S. budget deficit swells to almost $2 trillion for fiscal 2026, up 12% in a single year. Analysis: Everyone expects the Fed to hold rates in October. Kevin Warsh could surprise us all. Economists: Hot PPI shows Fed's work is not done.
global: Missiles hit Kyiv after Russia agrees to US call to resume Ukraine peace talks. Rosenberg: US diplomatic push offers little hope for imminent Ukraine peace. Macron accuses foreign leaders of exploiting French riots. Pope does not need further treatment after lung cancer surgery. 'Targeted' attack on much-loved MP leaves Australian town heartbroken. The "trillion pound" oil fund the government believes Britain could have built.
philippines: The tree Quezon planted, and Bacolod nearly forgot. LIVE UPDATES: Impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte. [Puso at Diwa] Sara Duterte trial: Is the space for political impunity finally closing?. Intense rain possible in Batanes even as Super Typhoon Rosal weakens further.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
